title: World Border Variant
description: RPG Theme, Changes the world border to a clear and distinguished border
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/955/983/world-border-variant-header.png) **DESCRIPTION** This simple world border variant resource pack replaces the default vanilla border image to a modern and easier to spot world border.   The vanilla border can sometimes be hard to spot in day time and you have to get really close to it to view. You can now view your world border from a distance with ease.  This also shows a different coloured tint at night time.
